local_root_cause: In the exact82ff helper, cancellation/detach/closure booleans are captured before its 25ms await. Real same-request cancellation events delivered behind a real continueRequest rejection do not update those snapshots. The maintained controlled Chromium fixture demonstrates that case; these imposed delivery schedules do not prove hosted causation.
fix: Await Performance.getMetrics response before dispatching Fetch.continueRequest. The browser Timestamp predates command dispatch and therefore actual rejection, independently of command scheduling or delayed error delivery. Only the same network-id request canceled at or before this sample, with ordered document replacement, same-document navigation or detach evidence, can excuse Invalid InterceptionId. Missing proof remains a failure. Closure or later navigation cannot launder a live invalid id. A missing network binding retains immediate continuation and fails closed on an invalid id. Pending handlers still settle.
